message:
You know those moments when you realize you’re not quite as prepared as you thought? The other day, we were packing our go-bags for a little family outing, you know, just in case. We were feeling pretty good about it until we discovered that one of our bags had a mismatched sock collection instead of snacks! 😂 It made us laugh, but it also reminded us how easy it is to overlook the essentials. 

So, while we might not be perfectly ready every time, we’re learning to check our bags more often and keep a little checklist handy. What’s your funniest ‘not ready’ moment? Let’s share some laughs while we prep!
